mechanism_narrative: Accelerating decline in RETAIL_REC over the past four weeks (from -16.1% to -29.1%) reflects a self-reinforcing contraction in discretionary mobility. This momentum persists into the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further negative as behavioral avoidance becomes entrenched.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined 13 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days, or the week-on-week decline rate reverses to positive for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has risen steadily (7.0% to 13.7%) while RETAIL_REC has fallen sharply, indicating a substitution of home-based for out-of-home activity. This behavioral shift is sticky; elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility suppresses RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds 12% while RETAIL_REC remains below -25%
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose 6.7 points while RETAIL_REC fell 13 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers to within 5 percentage points of baseline while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above 10%, or RESIDENTIAL declines below 8% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has collapsed by 11.9 percentage points over four weeks (from -15.1% to -27.0%), signaling enforcement of movement restrictions or voluntary avoidance of public transport. Sustained low TRANSIT access constrains RETAIL_REC recovery by reducing foot traffic to retail zones over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility recovers above -20% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 5 percentage points despite TRANSIT remaining below -25%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has remained elevated (19.4% to 26.1%) across the four-week window, reflecting sustained essential shopping demand. This essential-goods traffic generates spillover foot traffic to adjacent retail zones, providing a floor for RETAIL_REC decline and enabling modest recovery over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 10% for two consecutive weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines more than 5 additional percentage points despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 15%.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has deteriorated sharply (from -5.3% to -19.9%), indicating widespread workplace closures or remote-work mandates. Reduced workplace presence eliminates weekday commuting-adjacent retail visits, suppressing RETAIL_REC recovery over the next two weeks until workplace reopening signals emerge.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES recovers above -10% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 3 percentage points despite WORKPLACES remaining below -15%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint contraction in TRANSIT (-27.0%) and WORKPLACES (-19.9%) signals a coordinated collapse in commuting infrastructure and workplace access. This dual constraint amplifies RETAIL_REC suppression by eliminating both the supply of workers and the demand from commuters; recovery requires both series to rebound simultaneously over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES recovers above threshold independently while RETAIL_REC remains depressed, or both series recover but RETAIL_REC fails to rise within four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined consistently (from -18.0% to -23.7%), indicating suppressed outdoor recreation. This outdoor-activity deficit may drive compensatory indoor retail-and-recreation visits as consumers seek alternative leisure venues over the next week, producing a modest RETAIL_REC rebound.
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above -15% within one week, or RETAIL_REC declines further despite PARKS remaining below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence between GROCERY_PHARM resilience (19.4%) and RETAIL_REC collapse (-29.1%) indicates selective restriction of non-essential retail while essential services remain accessible. If this policy regime persists, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed relative to GROCERY_PHARM over the next four weeks; recovery requires explicit reopening of non-essential retail.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds RETAIL_REC by more than 40 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:48.5 percentage point gap between categories
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers to within 20 percentage points of GROCERY_PHARM within four weeks, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below 10% signaling broader reopening.
